subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should native subagent completion routing become a supported public `sessions_spawn` argument and configurable default with restart-durable semantics?
rationale: This is a useful, technically coherent feature, but it permanently expands model-facing and operator-facing policy for whether completion output reaches the user channel or only wakes the requester session.

options.title: Sponsor the full routing contract
options.body: Keep the per-spawn and config surfaces, fix the generated artifact, and require exact-head upgrade and both-route proof.

options.title: Narrow to explicit per-spawn routing
options.body: Remove the two config defaults and durable policy surface while retaining caller-selected parent routing for orchestration.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep current channel completion behavior until maintainers design a broader parent-handoff and callback contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full routing contract
recommendation.body: Keep the per-spawn and config surfaces, fix the generated artifact, and require exact-head upgrade and both-route proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged history across the central subagent spawn, delivery, lifecycle, and tool surfaces and is the best available owner for the public agent-runtime contract.
